summary: The ETraining system integrates with an external training platform, likely Moodle, to authenticate users and redirect them based on their session data and locale settings.
purpose: To manage user authentication and redirection to an external training module.

fields.name: form1
fields.description: Main form for submitting user credentials.

fields.name: username
fields.description: Stores the username, constructed from the user's province code and user ID.

fields.name: password
fields.description: Stores the session ID as a password for authentication.

fields.name: Submit
fields.description: Submit button styled for user interaction.

actors.name: UserSession
actors.role: Holds session information for the user, including session ID and locale.

workflows.name: User Authentication and Moodle Redirection
steps: UserSession is checked for a valid session ID.
Form action URL is set to login endpoint of MoodleTrainingURL with optional locale parameter for French.
Username is set using a combination of ProvinceCode and UserID.
Password is set using the SessionID.
If session ID is invalid, redirect to Timedout.aspx with session query string.

business_rules: User must have a valid session ID to proceed.
Form action URL is dynamically constructed based on user locale settings.
conditions: Check if UserSession.SessionID > 0 for valid session.
If UserSession.Locale is 'fr-CA', append language parameter to login URL.
system_behavior: Redirect user to Timedout.aspx if session is invalid.
Dynamically construct login URL based on configuration and session data.
